campaign: Embedded GUI: typed runtime authority, common operations, and bounded artifact workflows
doctrine: Follow skill.md. This file is the SINGLE execution authority. Keep the browser thin; Go recipes, compiled plans, runtime sessions, RepoDB, and run evidence own behavior. Migrate each caller and delete displaced logic in the same wave.
